sloka: कच्चित्ते सफला वेदा: कच्चित्ते सफला: क्रिया: ।कच्चित्ते सफला दारा: कच्चित्ते सफलं श्रुतम् ॥ २.१००.७३॥
transliteration: kaccitte saphalā vedā: kaccitte saphalā: kriyā: ।kaccitte saphalā dārā: kaccitte saphalaṁ śrutam ॥ 2.100.73॥

translations.english: O Bharata, I trust your intellect is in conformity with what I said conducive to long life, and fame in accordance with righteousness, (legitimate) pleasure and prosperity.
